SELECT survey_id, user_language, COUNT(*) as n, AVG(value) as avg_v,
               MIN(value) as min_v, MAX(value) as max_v
        FROM qualtrics__response
        WHERE survey_id = 'SUR10001791916'
        GROUP BY user_language
